name: Katapic: AI Visibility Toolkit for WooCommerce (llms.txt, Schema, AEO)
author: Leomat

sections.description:
AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google’s AI results read your product data before they read your marketing copy. If that data is thin or unstructured, they cannot describe your products properly, and cannot recommend them with any confidence.

This plugin makes your WooCommerce catalog readable to them. For free, on your own site, with no account and no external calls.

What you get for free, immediately

Activate the plugin and four things start working. Each one can be switched off on its own.

  • /llms.txt: publishes a plain-text summary of your catalog (categories and products) at the root of your site, the file AI crawlers look for.
  • /agents.md: tells an AI agent how to actually read your store, pointing at the public read-only WooCommerce endpoints for products and categories. Shopify began publishing this on every store by default in spring 2026 and treats it as the canonical one of the two. WooCommerce publishes neither.
  • Product schema enrichment: fills in missing brand, GTIN and material inside the structured data WooCommerce already outputs, through the official WooCommerce filter. It never duplicates a block and never overwrites a value you already have.
  • FAQ structured data: adds FAQPage markup only when a product description genuinely contains questions and answers. No invented Q&A.

All four run locally on your server. Nothing is sent anywhere. You do not need a Katapic account, and you never have to connect anything.

An honest note on what this does and does not do. These tools make your product data machine-readable and complete. They do not, and cannot, guarantee that your products appear, rank or get cited in any search or AI engine. Nobody can promise that, and you should be careful with anyone who does.

Optional: connect to Katapic

If you want to go further than making the data readable, and actually measure and fix it, the plugin can connect your store to Katapic in one click. You do not create or copy any API keys: the plugin sets up the connection for you.

With the store connected you can:

  • See a visibility score for every product, on two separate axes: SEO (Google) and AI search / AEO (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).
  • Rewrite weak descriptions in bulk, review the before and after, then publish back to your store.
  • Fill the gaps that make products hard to find: thin descriptions, missing attributes, weak titles.
  • Work in 10 languages, with readability measured per language.

Connecting creates a WooCommerce REST API key (read/write) so Katapic can read your products and write back optimized descriptions. It never touches your customers, orders or payments. Katapic is a third-party service with a free plan: see External services below.

External services

The free AI-visibility tools above make no external calls. This section applies only if you choose to connect your store.

This plugin can connect your site to Katapic, a third-party SaaS hosted at app.katapic.com, to score and optimize your product listings.

  • When data is sent: when you click Connect to Katapic, and afterwards while your store stays connected.
  • What is sent on connect: your site address (URL), your store name, and a WooCommerce REST API key that the plugin generates on your store. Login and registration happen on app.katapic.com: your Katapic password is never seen by the plugin.
  • What Katapic does with it: uses the API key to read your products and write back optimized descriptions. It does not read or store your customers, orders or payment data.
  • Terms of Service: https://app.katapic.com/legal?type=terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://app.katapic.com/legal?type=privacy

You can disconnect at any time from this plugin’s page (which revokes the API key), or from WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. That is it: /llms.txt, /agents.md, schema enrichment and FAQ markup are already on. Visit yoursite.com/llms.txt to see it.
  3. To turn any of them off, or to connect your store to Katapic, go to WooCommerce → Katapic.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Katapic account to use this plugin?

No. The four AI-visibility tools (/llms.txt, /agents.md, schema enrichment, FAQ markup) work as soon as you activate the plugin, with no account and no data leaving your server. An account is only needed for the optional scoring and bulk-rewriting features.

What is llms.txt?

A plain-text file at the root of your site that summarizes what you sell, so AI crawlers can understand your catalog without parsing every page. This plugin generates and keeps it up to date from your real WooCommerce data.

Will this make my products show up in ChatGPT or Google?

It makes your product pages easier for them to read and understand, which is the part you control. It does not guarantee rankings or citations: those always depend on each search or AI engine, and no tool can promise them.

What is AEO / AI search optimization?

AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) means making your products clear and structured enough that AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity can find and describe them correctly. This plugin covers the structural part for free.

Will it duplicate the schema my SEO plugin already outputs?

No. It enriches the structured data WooCommerce already produces, through the official WooCommerce filter, and only fills fields that are empty. It never adds a second block and never overwrites your existing values.

Does it work with my theme or page builder?

Yes. It works on the WooCommerce product data, not on your templates, so your theme or page builder does not matter.

Is it free?

The plugin and its AI-visibility tools are free, with no account. Katapic, the optional connected service, has a free plan; paid plans unlock more AI usage.

What data does Katapic access if I connect?

Only your products. The connection is scoped so Katapic reads your catalog and writes back optimized descriptions. It does not access customers, orders or payments.

How do I disconnect?

Open WooCommerce → Katapic and click Disconnect: this revokes the API key on your store. The free local tools keep working.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Documentation only, no functional change. The feature list still said three features after /agents.md made it four, in four places, and the one-line summary at the top was two characters over the limit WordPress allows, so it was being cut short.

1.2.0

  • New: /agents.md, switchable like the rest. Where /llms.txt summarises what you sell, agents.md says where the machine-readable catalog is: the public read-only WooCommerce product and category endpoints, plus the store pages you actually have configured. Nothing is invented, and no contact detail is published that your store has not already made public.
  • New: the plugin now tells you when more than one plugin is describing your products to search engines. WooCommerce emits a Product structured-data block, and Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO may emit their own; when a page carries several, the crawler picks one and it may not be the fullest. You get told which one to switch off and where the setting lives.
  • On purpose, we do not turn off another plugin’s schema for you. It is your site and your choice, and a silent change to a plugin you configured is the kind of thing that breaks a site weeks later with nothing pointing back at us.
  • Unchanged and worth repeating: these tools make your product data readable. They do not, and cannot, guarantee that anyone cites you. A study across roughly 300,000 domains found no citation lift from publishing /llms.txt on its own.

1.1.1

  • Repositioned: the free, local AI-visibility tools are now what the plugin leads with, because they are what most stores need first and they work without an account. No functional change.
  • Corrected the description, which previously implied a Katapic account was required for everything. /llms.txt, schema enrichment and FAQ markup have never needed one.
  • New FAQ entries on llms.txt and on schema duplication with other SEO plugins.

1.1.0

  • New: AI Search (AEO) tools, all local to your site and individually switchable: /llms.txt catalog summary for AI crawlers; enrichment of the existing WooCommerce product structured data (fills missing brand, GTIN, material: never duplicates); FAQPage markup generated only from Q&A really present in the product description.
  • No new data is sent to Katapic or anywhere else by these features.

1.0.2

  • Clearer plugin name and description so merchants searching for SEO / AI product descriptions can find it. Added details on SEO + AI search (AEO) and new FAQs. No change to functionality.

1.0.1

  • Clearer, more accurate wording in the plugin description and admin screen: no change to functionality.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: one-click connection to Katapic with automatic product import.
